intro: A structured curriculum for teaching yourself how LLMs and AI agents actually work — from first principles to advanced internals. Each lesson is a self-contained deep dive. Work through them in order.

lessons.title: How Deep Neural Networks Really Work
lessons.description: The foundations. What a neural network actually is, why stacking ReLUs can approximate any function, and how gradient descent tunes millions of parameters. Start here.

lessons.title: Build a Neural Network in a Spreadsheet
lessons.description: Theory into practice. Build a working neural network from scratch in a spreadsheet — no code, no libraries, just arithmetic you can see and touch. Train it on real Titanic passenger data.

lessons.title: Anatomy of an AI Coding Agent
lessons.description: From models to agents. What separates a chatbot from an agent, the six building blocks every production coding agent shares, how a single request flows from keystroke to output, and how permission systems keep an autonomous loop safe.
